title: Squared norm of the orthogonal projection onto a 2-plane spanned by an orthonormal pair
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, Q a linear subspace of ℝ^P with dim Q = 2, a, e ∈ Q with |a| = |e| = 1 and ⟨a,e⟩ = 0, and x ∈ ℝ^P. Then |Q.starProjection x|² = ⟨x,a⟩² + ⟨x,e⟩².
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (a e x : Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ Q = 2 → a ∈ Q → e ∈ Q → ‖a‖ = 1 → ‖e‖ = 1 → inner ℝ a e = 0 → ‖Q.starProjection x‖ ^ 2 = inner ℝ x a ^ 2 + inner ℝ x e ^ 2
